### The Lord Returns to His Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-returns-his-temple
Passage: Ezekiel 43:1-12
Points:
- Ezekiel's vision of the divine glory cloud filling the temple assured the exiles that God had not permanently rejected them.
- The Lord remains faithful to His covenant promises even after necessary seasons of discipline and judgment.
- Returning from the east, God's presence brings restoration and calls His people to put away all idolatry.
- The vision anticipates the arrival of Jesus Christ, who came in divine glory to cleanse His people from sin.

### Bible Pathways - Sept. 13, 2008
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-sept-13-2008-11581739.html
Passage: Ezekiel 43:6
Points:
- Ezekiel was granted a vision of the Lord's glorious return because his heart was eager to please God.
- Unlike religious authorities who relied on human intellect and failed to discern God's voice, Ezekiel listened attentively.
- Spiritual vitality depends on spending meaningful time listening to God speak through His Word.
- True acceptance and effective service before the Lord require a lifestyle of humble obedience.
- The divine glory filling the temple foreshadows Jesus Christ as the express image of God.
